papers.title: RoboEvo$^2$: Recursive Robot Self-Improvement via Harness-Policy Co-Evolution
papers.abstract_snippet: Robots should adapt to unfamiliar environments and acquire new skills through interaction, then execute those skills efficiently with practice. Vision-language-action policies provide efficient control, but often need additional human demonstrations to handle unfamiliar settings; reasoning agents can discover solutions using broad prior knowledge and robot-control APIs, but repeated deliberation and repair are costly. Inspired by human learning through reasoning and practice, we propose RoboEvo$
papers.reason: 提出 harness（推理/技能编排层）与底层 VLA 策略协同演化、递归自我改进的框架，试图让机器人在无额外人类示教下适应新环境并把新技能练熟。想法切中 VLA 数据瓶颈，但摘要片段未给出具体演算法、benchmark 与量化结果，需读正文确认是否落到实处。
